# Environment Setup

```{r setup}
# Packages
library(rprojroot)
library(tidyverse)
library(pomp)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(doRNG)
library(patchwork)
library(GGally)
library(lubridate)
library(formattable)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

# Set Random Seed
nb_name <-  "Cholera modelling with compartmental models and pomp - no disaster, new data"
seed <- sum(sapply(str_split(nb_name, pattern = "", simplify = TRUE), FUN = utf8ToInt))

# Parallel Computing
n_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
registerDoParallel(n_cores)
registerDoRNG(seed)

# Folder Structure
root <- has_file("cholera-surveillance.Rproj")$make_fix_file()
raw_data_dir <- root("data/raw")
proc_data_dir <- root("data/processed")
output_models_dir <- root("models_output/models")
dir.create(output_models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output_params_dir <- root("models_output/parameters")
dir.create(output_params_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
img_dir <- root("images")
dir.create(img_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
src_dir <- root("src")

# Local Packages
model_builder <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "model_builder_new_vacc_2.R"), local=model_builder)
global_searches <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "run_global_searches.R"), local=global_searches)
NegBin <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "optimize_arnb.R"), local=NegBin)
viz <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "viz.R"), local=viz)
```

# Functions

```{r}
symlog <- function(x) {
  symlogx <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    if (is.na(x[i])) {
      symlogx[i] <- NA
    }
    else if (abs(x[i]) < 1e-5) {
      symlogx[i] <- x[i]
    }
    else if (x[i] > 0) {
      symlogx[i] <- log(x[i])
    }
    else {
      symlogx[i] <- -log(-x[i])
    }
  }
  return(symlogx)
}

normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}
```

# Computational Parameters

```{r}
reset_data <- TRUE
run_level <- 2
Np <- switch(run_level, 100, 1e3, 5e3)
Nmif <- switch(run_level, 20, 100, 200)
Nreps <- switch(run_level, 10, 20, 100)
Nreps_eval <- switch(run_level, 2, 10, 20)
Nsim <- switch(run_level, 50, 100, 500)
profile_pts <- switch(run_level, 3, 5, 30)
profile_Nreps <- switch(run_level, 2, 3, 10)
```

# Parameters

From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country= Birth and death rates are per person and per DAY (all rates in the model are daily rates). Note that one unit of time is one year and each time step is 1/52 so all times and rates need to be scaled to this. For example, an infectious period of 10 days needs to be expressed as the number of units (1/52): (10/7) \* (1/52). For the same reason birth and death rates that are collected as rate per year they only need to be scaled by the number of people but left as year estimates. The time step 1/52 is then applied during the pomp step.

```{r}
# Birth and death rates
# From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country=

df_dem <- tibble(
  date = df_reports$date[seq(1, length(df_reports$date), length.out=10)],
  deathrate = c(10.1, 9.9, 9.6, 9.4, 9.5, 9.7, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4) / (1000),
  birthrate = c(43.5, 43.4, 43, 42.7, 42.3, 42, 41.7, 41.3, 41, 40.7) * 1.05 / (1000) # rates are adjusted to better reflect data that Andrew shared
)
```

# Full model data

```{r}
df_full <- (
  df_reports
  %>% merge(
    df_dem,
    by="date",
    all.x=TRUE
  )
  %>% mutate(
    date = seq(-1, n()-2, by = 1) / 52,
    birthrate = zoo::na.approx(birthrate, na.rm=FALSE),  # We interpolated the rates
    deathrate = zoo::na.approx(deathrate, na.rm=FALSE)
  )
)
```

```{r}
output_model_name_1 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_1_no_dis_new_data.rda"
output_params_path_1 <- file.path(output_params_dir, "uvira_multioutbreak_1_no_dis_new_data.csv")
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_1 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
rw.sd_1 <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  Beta = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
Beta_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1, max = 1000)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
mu_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50) 
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 5)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.001, max = 0.4)


guess_points_1 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  Beta = Beta_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  mu_rs = mu_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses,
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_1)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_1))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_1, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_1 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_1, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_1
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = 0.5,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_1
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = 0.1)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_1 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_1, params=coef(m_global_1[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

### Collect and Save Results

```{r}
df_results_1 <- global_searches$collect_and_save_loglik(
  model_search = m_global_1,
  loglik_values = loglik_global_1,
  out_filename = output_params_path_1,
  reset_data = reset_data
)
```

#### Pair plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-asp: 1
cols <- names(guess_points_1)
cols_to_plot <- cols[!(cols %in% c("s_0", "e_0", "a_0", "i_0", "h_0", "r_0", "ra_0", "ri_0"))]
res_to_plot <- (
  df_results_1
  %>% filter(log_lik>max(log_lik) - 10)
  %>% bind_rows(guess_points_1)
  %>% mutate(
    type = if_else(is.na(log_lik), "guess", "result")
  )
  %>% arrange(type)
  %>% select(log_lik, all_of(cols_to_plot), type)
)
pairs(
  res_to_plot[1: dim(res_to_plot)[2] - 1],
  col=ifelse(res_to_plot$type == "guess", grey(0.5), "red"),
  cex.axis = 1.3
)
dev.print(
  device = png, 
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "pair_plot_1.png"),
  width = 600, 
  height = 600
)
```

```{r}
  global_searches$simulate_best_model(

  %>% mutate(
    date = df_reports$date[1] + weeks(round(date * 52))
  )
```
```{r}
)
```

# With Covariate Modulation

```{r}
output_model_name_2 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_2_no_dis_new_data.rda"
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_2 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
# Parameters 
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
cooling.fraction.50 <- 0.5 # Level of parameter variance after 50% of iterations
rw.sd_2 <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.003, max = 0.2)
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0, max = 100)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 200)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
mu_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)

guess_points_2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  a_cov = a_cov_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  mu_rs = mu_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_2)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_2))]

stew(
```

# With Covariate Regression Model

```{r}
output_model_name_3 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_3_no_dis_new_data.rda"
output_params_path_3 <- file.path(output_params_dir, "uvira_multioutbreak_3_no_dis_new_data.csv")
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_3 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
  use_cov_regression = TRUE,
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
# Parameters 
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2

  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),

  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp,
  a_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_1 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_2 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_3 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_4 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_5 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_6 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov_7 = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_3)

stew(
```

# With Separate Recovered, no hospitalized

```{r}
output_model_name_7 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_7_no_dis_new_data.rda"
output_params_path_7 <- file.path(output_params_dir, "uvira_multioutbreak_7_no_dis_new_data.csv")
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_7 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
  add_idps = TRUE,
  use_separate_recovery = TRUE
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
# Parameters 
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
cooling.fraction.50 <- 0.5 # Level of parameter variance after 50% of iterations
rw.sd_7 <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ra_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ri_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp,
  a_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_ras = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_ris = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  b_idps = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ra_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ri_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0, max = 100)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 200)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.5)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.1, max = 0.99)
mu_ras_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50)
mu_ris_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 1)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)
b_idps_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.2)


guess_points_7 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  ra_0 = ra_0_guesses,
  ri_0 = ri_0_guesses,
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  a_cov = a_cov_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  mu_ras = mu_ras_guesses,
  mu_ris = mu_ris_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses,
  b_idps = b_idps_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_7)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_7))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_7, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_7 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_7, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_7
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = 0.5,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_7
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = 0.1)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_7 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_7, params=coef(m_global_7[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

### Collect and Save Results

```{r}
df_results_7 <- global_searches$collect_and_save_loglik(
  model_search = m_global_7,
  loglik_values = loglik_global_7,
  out_filename = output_params_path_7,
  reset_data = reset_data
)
```

```{r}
    date = df_reports$date[1] + weeks(round(date * 52))
  )
```

```{r}
  vacc_prop = rw.sd_rp,
  f_v = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_vev = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_vs = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_ras = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_ris = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ra_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ri_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0, max = 100)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 200)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.5)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.1, max = 0.99)
vacc_prop_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 1)
f_v_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 1)
mu_vev_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, 200)
mu_vs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, 200)
mu_ras_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50)
mu_ris_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 50)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 1)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.2)


guess_points_10 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  ra_0 = ra_0_guesses,
  ri_0 = ri_0_guesses,
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  a_cov = a_cov_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  vacc_prop = vacc_prop_guesses,
  f_v = f_v_guesses,
  mu_vev = mu_vev_guesses,
  mu_vs = mu_vs_guesses,
  mu_ras = mu_ras_guesses,
  mu_ris = mu_ris_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_10)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_10))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_10, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_10 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_10, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_10
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = 0.5,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_10
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = 0.1)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_10 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_10, params=coef(m_global_10[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

```{r}
)
```

# Benchmarks

## Negative binomial IID Model

```{r}
nb_lik <- function(tau) {
  -sum(
    dnbinom(
      as.vector(obs(m_1)),
      size = exp(tau[1]),
      prob = exp(tau[2]),
      log = TRUE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
nb_mle <- optim(c(0, -5), nb_lik)
```

```{r}
nb_mle$par
```

```{r}
-nb_mle$value
```

## Negative Binomial AR1

```{r}
arnb <- NegBin$arnb_fit(
  data = as.vector(obs(m_1)),
  start_vals = c(20, 0.5, 1),
)
```

```{r}
arnb$theta
```

```{r}
arnb$ll
```

## ARMA model

```{r}
log_y <- log(as.vector(obs(m_1)) + 1)
arma_fit <- arima(
  log_y,
  order=c(2, 0, 2),
  seasonal=list(
    order=c(1, 0, 1),
    period=1
  )
)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$coef
```

# Collect results

```{r}

lls <- list(
  loglik_global_1[,1],
  loglik_global_2[,1],
  loglik_global_3[,1],
  loglik_global_4[,1],
  loglik_global_5[,1],
  loglik_global_6[,1],
  loglik_global_7[,1],
  loglik_global_8[,1],
  loglik_global_9[,1],
  loglik_global_10[,1]
)

mech_models <- list(
  m_global_1[[which.max(loglik_global_1[,1])]],
  m_global_2[[which.max(loglik_global_2[,1])]],
  m_global_3[[which.max(loglik_global_3[,1])]],
  m_global_4[[which.max(loglik_global_4[,1])]],
  m_global_5[[which.max(loglik_global_5[,1])]],
  m_global_6[[which.max(loglik_global_6[,1])]],
  m_global_7[[which.max(loglik_global_7[,1])]],
  m_global_8[[which.max(loglik_global_8[,1])]],
  m_global_9[[which.max(loglik_global_9[,1])]],
  m_global_10[[which.max(loglik_global_10[,1])]]
)

model_names <- c(
  paste0("m_", 1:10),
  "nb_iid",
  "nb_ar1",
  "SARIMA"
)

num_params <- sapply(mech_models, function(x) length(coef(x)) - 5)
num_params <- c(num_params, 2, 3, 7)
lls_best <- sapply(lls, max)
lls_best <- c(lls_best, -nb_mle$value, arnb$ll, arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y))
aics <- -2 * lls_best + 2 * num_params

df_summary <- data.frame(
  model = model_names,
  log_likelihood = lls_best,
  num_params = num_params,
  aic = aics
)
```

```{r}
df_summary
```
